class.name: OcgGpElips
class.brief_description: Describes an ellipse in 3D space. An ellipse is defined by its major and minor radii and positioned in space with a coordinate system (a gp_Ax2 object) as follows: - the origin of the coordinate system is the center of the ellipse, - its "X Direction" defines the major axis of the ellipse, and - its "Y Direction" defines the minor axis of the ellipse. Together, the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of this coordinate system define the plane of the ellipse. This coordinate system is the "local coordinate system" of the ellipse. In this coordinate system, the equation of the ellipse is: The "main Direction" of the local coordinate system gives the normal vector to the plane of the ellipse. This vector gives an implicit orientation to the ellipse (definition of the trigonometric sense). We refer to the "main Axis" of the local coordinate system as the "Axis" of the ellipse. See Also gce_MakeElips which provides functions for more complex ellipse constructions Geom_Ellipse which provides additional functions for constructing ellipses and works, in particular, with the parametric equations of ellipses
class.description: ! Describes an ellipse in 3D space. ! An ellipse is defined by its major and minor radii and ! positioned in space with a coordinate system (a gp_Ax2 object) as follows: ! - the origin of the coordinate system is the center of the ellipse, ! - its "X Direction" defines the major axis of the ellipse, and ! - its "Y Direction" defines the minor axis of the ellipse. ! Together, the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of ! this coordinate system define the plane of the ellipse. ! This coordinate system is the "local coordinate system" ! of the ellipse. In this coordinate system, the equation of ! the ellipse is: ! @code ! X*X / (MajorRadius**2) + Y*Y / (MinorRadius**2) = 1.0 ! @endcode ! The "main Direction" of the local coordinate system gives ! the normal vector to the plane of the ellipse. This vector ! gives an implicit orientation to the ellipse (definition of the ! trigonometric sense). We refer to the "main Axis" of the ! local coordinate system as the "Axis" of the ellipse. ! See Also ! gce_MakeElips which provides functions for more ! complex ellipse constructions ! Geom_Ellipse which provides additional functions for ! constructing ellipses and works, in particular, with the ! parametric equations of ellipses

method.name: gp_Elips
method.description: Creates an indefinite ellipse.

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Changes the axis normal to the plane of the ellipse. It modifies the definition of this plane. The "XAxis" and the "YAxis" are recomputed. The local coordinate system is redefined so that: - its origin and "main Direction" become those of the axis theA1 (the "X Direction" and "Y Direction" are then recomputed in the same way as for any gp_Ax2), or Raises ConstructionError if the direction of theA1 is parallel to the direction of the "XAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Modifies this ellipse, by redefining its local coordinate so that its origin becomes theP.

method.name: SetMajorRadius
method.description: The major radius of the ellipse is on the "XAxis" (major axis) of the ellipse. Raises ConstructionError if theMajorRadius < MinorRadius.

method.name: SetMinorRadius
method.description: The minor radius of the ellipse is on the "YAxis" (minor axis) of the ellipse. Raises ConstructionError if theMinorRadius > MajorRadius or MinorRadius < 0.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Modifies this ellipse, by redefining its local coordinate so that it becomes theA2.

method.name: Area
method.description: Computes the area of the Ellipse.

method.name: Axis
method.description: Computes the axis normal to the plane of the ellipse.

method.name: Directrix1
method.description: Computes the first or second directrix of this ellipse. These are the lines, in the plane of the ellipse, normal to the major axis, at a distance equal to MajorRadius/e from the center of the ellipse, where e is the eccentricity of the ellipse. The first directrix (Directrix1) is on the positive side of the major axis. The second directrix (Directrix2) is on the negative side. The directrix is returned as an axis (gp_Ax1 object), the origin of which is situated on the "X Axis" of the local coordinate system of this ellipse. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if the eccentricity is null (the ellipse has degenerated into a circle).

method.name: Directrix2
method.description: This line is obtained by the symmetrical transformation of "Directrix1" with respect to the "YAxis" of the ellipse. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if the eccentricity is null (the ellipse has degenerated into a circle).

method.name: Eccentricity
method.description: Returns the eccentricity of the ellipse between 0.0 and 1.0 If f is the distance between the center of the ellipse and the Focus1 then the eccentricity e = f / MajorRadius. Raises ConstructionError if MajorRadius = 0.0

method.name: Focal
method.description: Computes the focal distance. It is the distance between the two focus focus1 and focus2 of the ellipse.

method.name: Focus1
method.description: Returns the first focus of the ellipse. This focus is on the positive side of the "XAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: Focus2
method.description: Returns the second focus of the ellipse. This focus is on the negative side of the "XAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the center of the ellipse. It is the "Location" point of the coordinate system of the ellipse.

method.name: MajorRadius
method.description: Returns the major radius of the ellipse.

method.name: MinorRadius
method.description: Returns the minor radius of the ellipse.

method.name: Parameter
method.description: Returns p = (1 - e * e) * MajorRadius where e is the eccentricity of the ellipse. Returns 0 if MajorRadius = 0

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the coordinate system of the ellipse.

method.name: XAxis
method.description: Returns the "XAxis" of the ellipse whose origin is the center of this ellipse. It is the major axis of the ellipse.

method.name: YAxis
method.description: Returns the "YAxis" of the ellipse whose unit vector is the "X Direction" or the "Y Direction" of the local coordinate system of this ellipse. This is the minor axis of the ellipse.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of an ellipse with respect to the point theP which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of an ellipse with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of an ellipse with respect to a plane. The axis placement theA2 locates the plane of the symmetry (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates an ellipse. theA1 is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales an ellipse. theS is the scaling value.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms an ellipse with the transformation theT from class Trsf.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates an ellipse in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates an ellipse from the point theP1 to the point theP2.
